versions.subject: rule: process dumping lolbins
versions.detection:
selection1:
    Image|endswith: '\createdump.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -u '
        - ' -f '
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -u -f '
        - '.dmp '
condition: selection1 or selection2

versions.subject: Update proc_creation_win_proc_dump_createdump.yml
versions.detection:

    - OriginalFileName: 'FX_VER_INTERNALNAME_STR'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -u ' # Short version of '--full'

        - ' -f ' # Short version of '--name'

        - '.dmp '
condition: all of selection_*
